prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic overhead social-media portrait centered on freckles, natural hair texture and a playful wink-and-tongue expression.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with fair freckled skin, flushed pink cheeks, wavy blonde hair spread above her head, one brown eye open and the other winking. She wears a white halter-neck bikini top with black embroidered zig-zag trim, small gold hoop earrings and a delicate gold chain with a small dark charm.
prompt.composition_elements: Use a 2:3 overhead view of the adult subject lying on her back. Center the face and upper torso, retain a broad toothy smile with tongue extended and a lightly wrinkled nose, and fill the frame with a light-blue textured pillow and blanket.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural indoor light gives even highlights to freckles, cheeks, hair and white fabric with subtle shadows. Keep the mood playful, candid and approachable.
prompt.technical_specs: 2:3 vertical overhead smartphone framing, sharp facial focus, realistic freckles and hair strands, detailed textile texture, natural color and moderate contrast.

prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, body-part emphasis, child, teen, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted anatomy, unreadable text or logos
